sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reach out to our long-standing partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. For generations, our foundry has taken immense pride in delivering the highest craftsmanship from our region, built on mutual trust and open collaboration. 

Regarding our ongoing discussions, our current Angebot stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. 

However, I must be open with you: without movement from your side we cannot move either. We deeply value our shared history, and I am confident that we can find a good path forward together if both sides work in partnership. 

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

as a family-run foundry with a long tradition in our region, we have always valued our shared history and the relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH deeply. However, after careful consideration of the current situation, we must inform you that we are withdrawing from this negotiation. 

We thank you for the past conversations and wish your company all the best for the future.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
